.. py:class:: LSTMTrainer(interval: str, tensorboard_log_dir: str = './logs/hparams_LTSM')



LSTM Model training manager with hyperparameter tuning using hparams and keras tune.
       


.. py:attribute:: __interval
      :type:  float

.. py:attribute:: __model
      :type:  tensorflow.keras.Sequential
      :value: None


.. py:attribute:: __best_model_path
      :type:  str
      :value: 'best_ltsm_Uninferable.keras'


.. py:attribute:: __cm_file_path
      :type:  str
      :value: None


.. py:attribute:: __tensorboard_log_dir
      :type:  str
      :value: './logs/hparams_LTSM'

      :type:  float
      :value: 0.0

      :value: None

      :value: None

.. py:method:: __model_generator(input_shape: tuple[int, int], output_shape: int) -> None

      LEGACY - Generate a model with the given input and output shape.

      :param input_shape: Input shape of the model
      :type input_shape: tuple[int, int]
      :param output_shape: Output shape of the model
      :type output_shape: int


.. py:method:: train_with_hparams(X: numpy.ndarray, y: numpy.ndarray, X_val: numpy.ndarray = None, y_val: numpy.ndarray = None, X_test: numpy.ndarray = None, y_test: numpy.ndarray = None, epochs: int = 10, batch_size: int = 1, num_cats: int = 6, categories: list[str] = None) -> None

      Train the model with all the combinations of hyperparameters.

      :param X: Input training data
      :type X: np.ndarray
      :param y: Input training categories
      :type y: np.ndarray
      :param X_val: Validation input data, defaults to None
      :type X_val: np.ndarray, optional
      :param y_val: Validation categories data, defaults to None
      :type y_val: np.ndarray, optional
      :param X_test: Test input data, defaults to None
      :type X_test: np.ndarray, optional
      :param y_test: Test categories data, defaults to None
      :type y_test: np.ndarray, optional
      :param epochs: Number of epochs, defaults to 10
      :type epochs: int, optional
      :param batch_size: Batch size, defaults to 1
      :type batch_size: int, optional
      :param num_cats: Number of categories, defaults to 6
      :type num_cats: int, optional
      :param categories: List of categories, defaults to None
      :type categories: list[str], optional


.. py:method:: train(X: numpy.ndarray, y: numpy.ndarray, X_val: numpy.ndarray = None, y_val: numpy.ndarray = None, epochs: int = 10, batch_size: int = 1, num_cats: int = 6, categories: list[str] = None) -> None

      Train the model with the given parameters.

      :param X: Input training data
      :type X: np.ndarray
      :param y: Input training categories
      :type y: np.ndarray
      :param X_val: Validation input data, defaults to None
      :type X_val: np.ndarray, optional
      :param y_val: Validation categories data, defaults to None
      :type y_val: np.ndarray, optional
      :param epochs: Number of epochs, defaults to 10
      :type epochs: int, optional
      :param batch_size: Batch size, defaults to 1
      :type batch_size: int, optional
      :param num_cats: Number of categories, defaults to 6
      :type num_cats: int, optional
      :param categories: List of categories, defaults to None
      :type categories: list[str], optional


.. py:method:: __build_model(hp: keras_tuner.HyperParameters) -> tensorflow.keras.Model

      Build the model with the given hyperparameters.

      :param hp: Hyperparameters (automatically created by keras tuner)
      :type hp: HyperParameters
      :return: Compiled Keras model
      :rtype: tf.keras.Model


.. py:method:: __update_best_args(acc: float, hparams: dict = None) -> None

      Update the best arguments with the new accuracy and time.

      :param acc: New accuracy value
      :type acc: float
      :param hparams: Hyperparameters dictionary, defaults to None
      :type hparams: dict, optional


.. py:method:: save_model() -> None

      Save the model to a file.

      :raises ValueError: If the model is not initialized


.. py:method:: best_model() -> str

      Get the best model path.

      :return: Path to the best model
      :rtype: str


.. py:method:: confusion_matrix(filename: str, y_true: numpy.ndarray, y_pred: numpy.ndarray, tags: list[str]) -> str

      Generate a confusion matrix for the given model.

      :param filename: Path to the model file
      :type filename: str
      :param y_true: True labels
      :type y_true: np.ndarray
      :param y_pred: Predicted labels
      :type y_pred: np.ndarray
      :param tags: List of tags
      :type tags: list[str]
      :return: Path to the confusion matrix image
      :rtype: str


.. py:method:: get_best_acc() -> float

      Get the best accuracy.

      :return: Best accuracy value
      :rtype: float


.. py:method:: get_confusion_matrix() -> str

      Get the confusion matrix.

      :return: Path to the confusion matrix image
      :rtype: str


.. py:method:: stats() -> str

      Get the stats of the model.

      :return: Stats of the model
      :rtype: str


.. py:method:: predict(X: numpy.ndarray) -> numpy.ndarray

      Predict the output for the given input.

      :param X: Input data
      :type X: np.ndarray
      :return: Predicted output
      :rtype: np.ndarray
      :raises ValueError: If the model is not initialized


.. py:method:: get_log_dir() -> str

      Get the log directory.

      :return: Log directory path
      :rtype: str
